name: Sample · Standard NGO Procurement Policy 2026
interpretation_notes: This is a sample rulebook bundled with DOCex so new users can see the Compliance Check flow end-to-end without uploading their own policy first. The rules below reflect common NGO procurement controls drawn from BMGF, USAID 2 CFR 200, and standard NGO finance manuals. Clone this rulebook and edit the rules to match your own policy — every rule is independently editable, deactivatable, or removable.

rules.description: Purchases above ₦500,000 must include three independent vendor quotations attached to the payment request.
evidence_required: Three quotation documents from distinct vendors
Bid analysis or vendor selection memo
rules.source_quote: All procurements with value exceeding five hundred thousand naira (₦500,000) require three independent quotations from registered vendors.

rules.description: Purchases above ₦1,000,000 require sign-off by the Director of Operations or equivalent.
evidence_required: Signed approval from Director or equivalent
Date of approval predates payment date
rules.source_quote: Procurements in excess of one million naira require written approval from the Director of Operations prior to commitment.

rules.description: Every vendor must be CAC-registered. CAC registration certificate must be on file before any payment is released.
rules.source_quote: All vendors must produce evidence of registration with the Corporate Affairs Commission (CAC) before any commitment is made.

rules.description: Invoices must carry the vendor address, TIN (where applicable), invoice date, and itemised line items.
rules.source_quote: All invoices submitted for payment must include the vendor's full address, tax identification number where applicable, date of issue, and itemised description of goods or services.

rules.description: For goods purchases, a signed Goods Received Note (GRN) must accompany the payment request, signed by the receiver and storekeeper.
evidence_required: GRN signed by storekeeper or equivalent
rules.source_quote: All goods deliveries must be confirmed via a Goods Received Note (GRN) signed by both the receiver and the storekeeper before payment is processed.

rules.description: Travel advances must be retired with supporting receipts within 14 days of trip completion.
rules.source_quote: All travel advances must be fully retired with supporting documentation within fourteen (14) calendar days of trip completion. Unretired advances are recoverable from staff salaries.

rules.description: Cash payments above ₦100,000 are prohibited. Payments must be made via bank transfer.
evidence_required: Bank transfer confirmation or payment voucher referencing a bank account
rules.source_quote: No cash disbursement in excess of one hundred thousand naira (₦100,000) shall be permitted under any circumstance. All such payments must be effected through bank transfer.

rules.description: Per-diem payments to event attendees and staff must follow the approved rate card on file.
evidence_required: Rate card reference number or version
Per-diem calculation showing days × approved rate
rules.source_quote: Per-diem rates are governed by the approved rate card published annually. Payments must match the rate-card amount for the recipient's role and event type.

rules.description: Every payment must be backed by an approved requisition signed prior to the commitment date.
rules.source_quote: All disbursements must be supported by a duly approved requisition. The requisition must be signed by an authorised approver prior to the commitment of funds.

rules.description: Receipts must be originals (or signed scans). Photocopies without endorsement are not acceptable.
rules.source_quote: Only original receipts, or photocopies bearing the authorised endorsement of the finance officer, shall be acceptable as supporting documentation for any payment.
